scripts.og: node scripts/build.mjs && npx --yes playwright@1 screenshot --viewport-size=1200,630 --wait-for-timeout=1500 dist/og.html assets/og.png && python3 -c "from PIL import Image; Image.open('assets/og.png').convert('RGB').quantize(32, dither=Image.NONE).save('assets/og.png', optimize=True)"
scripts.qr: node -e "const u=require('./links.json').site.url.replace(/\/$/,'');process.stdout.write(u+'/?utm_source=qr')" | xargs -I{} npx --yes qrcode@1 -t svg -e M -q 2 -o assets/qr.svg {}
